limitations: Public development/evaluation benchmarks, not sealed or known-unseen tests.
Intervals reflect resampling selected questions/patterns, not training-seed or broader benchmark uncertainty.
Only base and selected adapter were measured; no matched Intern or Kev comparison.
Whole-adapter comparison cannot isolate which training change caused the result.
Question text and per-question outputs are not redistributed in this aggregate summary.
